CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION workhub_private.p2_member_reachable(p_school_id text, p_membership_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM workhub.memberships m JOIN workhub.accounts a ON a.id = m.account_id JOIN workhub.schools s ON s.id = m.school_id
     WHERE m.school_id = p_school_id AND m.id = p_membership_id AND m.status = 'active' AND s.status = 'active'
       AND workhub_private.today_in(s.timezone) <@ daterange(m.valid_from, m.valid_to, '[)')
       AND a.status = 'active' AND a.legacy_approval_state = 'approved'
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users u WHERE u.id = a.auth_user_id::text AND u.is_active AND u.role = 'superadmin'))
$function$

name: t2_publish_plan
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION workhub_private.t2_publish_plan(p_ctx workhub_private.actor_context, i jsonb, p_preview text, p_cutoff timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_range daterange := workhub_private.t2_publish_input(i); v_tz text := p_ctx.school_timezone; d workhub.timetable_drafts; t workhub.terms;
        b workhub.timetable_basis_revisions; v_excluded jsonb; v_rows jsonb; v_blockers jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; v_missing integer; v_busy jsonb; v_conf text[];
        v_partial jsonb; v_closed jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO d FROM workhub.timetable_drafts WHERE school_id = p_ctx.school_id AND id = i ->> 'draftId';
  IF d.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
  IF (i -> 'draftVersion') <> '1'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONFLICT'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO t FROM workhub.terms WHERE school_id = d.school_id AND id = d.term_id;
  IF t.state = 'closed' OR t.ends_on <= p_ctx.school_today THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONFLICT'; END IF;
  -- 공개 기간은 그 편성 초안의 학기 안이어야 한다(학기 밖 날짜에 이 학기 배치를 펼치지 않는다)
  IF lower(v_range) < t.starts_on OR upper(v_range) > t.ends_on THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INPUT'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO b FROM workhub.timetable_basis_revisions WHERE school_id = d.school_id AND id = d.basis_id;
  v_excluded := workhub_private.t2_closed_days(p_ctx.school_id, lower(v_range), upper(v_range));

  WITH res AS (
    SELECT r ->> 'id' AS id, r ->> 'kind' AS kind, r ->> 'label' AS label, COALESCE((r ->> 'capacity')::integer, 1) AS cap FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.basis -> 'resources') r
  ), bl AS (
    SELECT l ->> 'id' AS act, l ->> 'courseId' AS course, l ->> 'label' AS label,
           ARRAY(SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(l -> 'allowedSlotIds') x) AS allowed,
           ARRAY(SELECT rid FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(l -> 'resourceIds') WITH ORDINALITY z(rid, o) JOIN res ON res.id = z.rid AND res.kind = 'teacher' ORDER BY z.o) AS teachers,
           COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', res.id, 'name', res.label) ORDER BY z.o) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(l -> 'resourceIds') WITH ORDINALITY z(rid, o)
                      JOIN res ON res.id = z.rid AND res.kind IN ('class','student_group')), '[]'::jsonb) AS groups,
           COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', res.id, 'name', res.label) ORDER BY z.o) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(l -> 'resourceIds') WITH ORDINALITY z(rid, o)
                      JOIN res ON res.id = z.rid AND res.kind = 'room'), '[]'::jsonb) AS rooms,
           COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', res.id, 'kind', res.kind, 'capacity', res.cap) ORDER BY z.o) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(l -> 'resourceIds') WITH ORDINALITY z(rid, o)
                      JOIN res ON res.id = z.rid), '[]'::jsonb) AS uses
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.basis -> 'lessons') l
  ), pl AS (   -- 기간의 날짜마다 펼친 배치(휴업일 제외)
    SELECT bl.*, dd::date AS occ, workhub_private.t2_at(dd::date, (s ->> 'startMinute')::integer, v_tz) AS s, workhub_private.t2_at(dd::date, (s ->> 'endMinute')::integer, v_tz) AS e
      FROM generate_series(lower(v_range)::timestamp, (upper(v_range) - 1)::timestamp, interval '1 day') dd
      CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements(d.placements) p
      JOIN bl ON bl.act = p ->> 'lessonId'
      JOIN jsonb_array_elements(b.basis -> 'slots') s ON s ->> 'id' = p ->> 'slotId' AND (s ->> 'day')::integer = extract(isodow FROM dd)::integer
     WHERE NOT (v_excluded @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('date', to_char(dd::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))))
  ), ex AS (   -- 지금 살아 있는 수업 + 학사 변경으로 취소한 수업(이 학기 · 기간의 원래 날짜)
    -- 학사 변경(휴업)으로 취소한 occurrence 는 pinned 로 남아 재공개에서도 되살리지 않는다. 일반 재공개 취소 이력(changed_by='publish')은
    -- 넣지 않으므로 다시 배치하면 새로 만든다. 한 occurrence 에 행이 여럿이면 살아 있는 행 → 가장 최근 학사 변경 취소 하나만 맞춘다.
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.activity_id, l.occurrence_date) l AS r, l.activity_id AS act, l.occurrence_date AS occ FROM workhub.timetable_lessons l
     WHERE l.school_id = d.school_id AND l.term_id = d.term_id AND l.occurrence_date >= lower(v_range) AND l.occurrence_date < upper(v_range)
       AND (l.state <> 'cancelled' OR (l.pinned AND l.changed_by IN ('school_day','intervention')))
     ORDER BY l.activity_id, l.occurrence_date, (l.state = 'cancelled'), l.changed_at DESC, l.id COLLATE "C"
  ), cl AS (   -- 그 학교 · 날짜의 휴업 학급(휴업 기록 여러 건의 합집합)
    SELECT (c.input ->> 'date')::date AS day, array_agg(DISTINCT g.v) AS gids
      FROM workhub.timetable_school_day_changes c CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(c.input -> 'groupIds') g(v)
     WHERE c.school_id = d.school_id AND c.input ->> 'kind' = 'closure'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workhub.timetable_reopened_days rd WHERE rd.school_id=c.school_id AND rd.school_day_change_id=c.id)
       AND (c.input ->> 'date')::date >= lower(v_range) AND (c.input ->> 'date')::date < upper(v_range)
     GROUP BY 1
  ), j AS (
    SELECT pl.act AS p_act, pl.course AS p_course, pl.label AS p_label, pl.allowed AS p_allowed, pl.teachers AS p_teachers, pl.groups AS p_groups, pl.rooms AS p_rooms,
           pl.uses AS p_uses, pl.occ AS p_occ, pl.s AS p_s, pl.e AS p_e, ex.r AS e_row,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(pl.groups) g JOIN cl ON cl.day = pl.occ AND (g ->> 'id') = ANY (cl.gids)) AS p_closed
      FROM pl FULL JOIN ex ON ex.act = pl.act AND ex.occ = pl.occ
  ), k AS (
    SELECT j.*, CASE
        WHEN (e_row).id IS NOT NULL AND (e_row).starts_at <= p_cutoff THEN NULL          -- 이미 시작한 수업: 그대로(지난 기록)
        WHEN p_act IS NOT NULL AND p_s <= p_cutoff THEN NULL                               -- 계획 시각이 이미 지남: 그대로
        WHEN (e_row).id IS NOT NULL AND (e_row).pinned THEN NULL                           -- 교환 · 학사 변경(휴업 취소 포함) 수업: 그대로(retained)
        WHEN (e_row).id IS NULL AND p_act IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(p_groups) > 0
             AND p_closed = jsonb_array_length(p_groups) THEN NULL                          -- 학급이 전부 휴업인 날: 새로 만들지 않음
        WHEN p_act IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(p_teachers) = 0 THEN 'skip'                 -- 담당 교사 없는 수업: 공개하지 않음(차단)
        WHEN (e_row).id IS NULL THEN 'new'
        WHEN p_act IS NULL THEN 'cancel'
        WHEN (e_row).label = p_label AND (e_row).starts_at = p_s AND (e_row).ends_at = p_e AND (e_row).teacher_ids = p_teachers AND (e_row).groups = p_groups
             AND (e_row).rooms = p_rooms AND (e_row).uses = p_uses AND (e_row).allowed_slot_ids = p_allowed AND (e_row).course_id = p_course THEN NULL
        ELSE 'update' END AS kind
      FROM j
  )
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM k WHERE kind = 'skip'),
         COALESCE(jsonb_agg(CASE kind
           WHEN 'new' THEN jsonb_build_object('k', 'new', 'id', workhub_private.t2_new_id(p_preview, p_act, p_occ), 'version', 1, 'act', p_act, 'course', p_course,
             'occ', p_occ, 'label', p_label, 's', p_s, 'e', p_e, 'teachers', to_jsonb(p_teachers), 'groups', p_groups, 'rooms', p_rooms, 'uses', p_uses,
             'allowed', to_jsonb(p_allowed), 'before', NULL,
             'after', workhub_private.t2_plesson(workhub_private.t2_new_id(p_preview, p_act, p_occ), 1, p_label, p_s, p_e, p_teachers, p_groups, p_rooms, 'scheduled'))
           WHEN 'update' THEN jsonb_build_object('k', 'update', 'id', (e_row).id, 'version', (e_row).version + 1, 'act', p_act, 'course', p_course, 'occ', p_occ,
             'label', p_label, 's', p_s, 'e', p_e, 'teachers', to_jsonb(p_teachers), 'groups', p_groups, 'rooms', p_rooms, 'uses', p_uses, 'allowed', to_jsonb(p_allowed),
             'before', workhub_private.t2_lesson(e_row, false, '[]'::jsonb),
             'after', workhub_private.t2_plesson((e_row).id, (e_row).version + 1, p_label, p_s, p_e, p_teachers, p_groups, p_rooms, 'scheduled'))
           ELSE jsonb_build_object('k', 'cancel', 'id', (e_row).id, 'version', (e_row).version + 1, 's', (e_row).starts_at, 'e', (e_row).ends_at,
             'before', workhub_private.t2_lesson(e_row, false, '[]'::jsonb),
             'after', workhub_private.t2_plesson((e_row).id, (e_row).version + 1, (e_row).label, (e_row).starts_at, (e_row).ends_at, (e_row).teacher_ids,
                                                 (e_row).groups, (e_row).rooms, 'cancelled')) END
           ORDER BY CASE WHEN kind = 'cancel' THEN (e_row).starts_at ELSE p_s END,
                    CASE WHEN kind = 'new' THEN workhub_private.t2_new_id(p_preview, p_act, p_occ) ELSE (e_row).id END)
           FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('new','update','cancel')), '[]'::jsonb),
         jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN kind = 'new' THEN workhub_private.t2_new_id(p_preview, p_act, p_occ) ELSE (e_row).id END
                   ORDER BY CASE WHEN kind = 'new' THEN workhub_private.t2_new_id(p_preview, p_act, p_occ) ELSE (e_row).id END)
           FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('new','update') AND p_closed > 0 AND p_closed < jsonb_array_length(p_groups)),   -- 일부 학급만 휴업(합반)
         jsonb_agg((e_row).id ORDER BY (e_row).id)
           FILTER (WHERE kind = 'update' AND p_closed > 0 AND p_closed = jsonb_array_length(p_groups))             -- 바뀐 뒤 학급이 전부 휴업
    INTO v_missing, v_rows, v_partial, v_closed FROM k;

  -- 차단 사유(앱 blocker: code · message · lessonIds ⊆ 바뀌는 수업)
  IF d.basis_id IS DISTINCT FROM t.current_timetable_basis_id THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'BASIS_OUTDATED',
      'message', '이 편성 초안의 기준판이 학기의 현재 기준판이 아닙니다. 현재 기준판으로 편성 초안을 다시 저장해 주세요.', 'lessonIds', '[]'::jsonb));
  END IF;
  IF v_missing > 0 THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'TEACHER_MISSING',
      'message', format('담당 교사가 없는 수업 %s건은 공개할 수 없습니다. 수업 담당을 지정한 뒤 기준판을 다시 확정해 주세요.', v_missing), 'lessonIds', '[]'::jsonb));
  END IF;
  IF v_partial IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'PARTIAL_GROUP_SCOPE',
      'message', '휴업한 학급과 수업하는 학급이 섞인 합반 수업이 있습니다. 휴업 범위나 배치를 먼저 정리해 주세요.', 'lessonIds', v_partial));
  END IF;
  IF v_closed IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'SCHOOL_CLOSED',
      'message', '휴업한 학급의 수업으로 바뀌는 수업이 있습니다. 그날 수업은 학사 변경에서 정리하거나 배치를 바꿔 주세요.', 'lessonIds', v_closed));
  END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_agg(x ->> 'id' ORDER BY x ->> 'id') INTO v_busy FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) x
   WHERE x ->> 'k' <> 'new' AND workhub_private.t2_lesson_busy(p_ctx.school_id, x ->> 'id', p_cutoff);
  IF v_busy IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'EXISTING_REQUEST',
      'message', '진행 중인 교환 요청이 걸린 수업이 바뀝니다. 요청을 마무리(승인 · 거절 · 철회)한 뒤 다시 확인해 주세요.', 'lessonIds', v_busy));
  END IF;
  v_conf := workhub_private.t2_conflicts(p_ctx.school_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x ->> 'id', 's', x -> 's', 'e', x -> 'e', 'uses', x -> 'uses')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) x
               WHERE x ->> 'k' <> 'cancel'), '[]'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(ARRAY(SELECT x ->> 'id' FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) x WHERE x ->> 'k' = 'cancel'), ARRAY[]::text[]));
  IF cardinality(v_conf) > 0 THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT',
      'message', '같은 시간에 교사 · 학급 · 공간이 겹치는 수업이 있습니다(교환 · 학사 변경으로 옮긴 수업이나 다른 공개 시간표와 겹침).', 'lessonIds', to_jsonb(v_conf)));
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_rows) = 0 AND jsonb_array_length(v_blockers) = 0 THEN
    v_blockers := jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'NO_CHANGES', 'message', '이 기간에 새로 공개할 변경이 없습니다.', 'lessonIds', '[]'::jsonb));
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('rows', v_rows, 'blockers', v_blockers, 'excludedDays', v_excluded,
    'existingChanges', CASE WHEN v_busy IS NULL THEN 'retained' ELSE 'blocked' END,
    'termId', d.term_id, 'basisId', d.basis_id, 'draftId', d.id, 'unavailable', COALESCE(d.conditions -> 'unavailable', '[]'::jsonb),
    'title', d.title, 'from', lower(v_range), 'until', upper(v_range),
    'basisFingerprint', workhub_private.p2_sha(jsonb_build_object('basisId', b.id, 'basisRevision', b.revision, 'sourceFingerprint', b.source_fingerprint, 'draftId', d.id)));
END $function$

name: t2_school_day_calc
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION workhub_private.t2_school_day_calc(p_ctx workhub_private.actor_context, i jsonb, p_as_of timestamp with time zone, p_range daterange, p_id text, p_created timestamp with time zone, p_expires timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_tz text := p_ctx.school_timezone; v_date date := (i ->> 'date')::date; v_groups text[] := ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(i -> 'groupIds'));
        v_src jsonb; v_changes jsonb; v_effects jsonb; v_blockers jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; v_flags jsonb; v_conf boolean; v_body jsonb; v_lost bigint; v_cnt integer;
BEGIN
  IF v_date < lower(p_range) OR v_date >= upper(p_range) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INPUT'; END IF;
  IF NOT workhub_private.t2_unchanged(p_ctx.school_id, p_as_of, p_range, v_tz) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CONFLICT'; END IF;
  -- 화면이 본 수업(기간 · asOf)
  WITH vl AS (
    SELECT l.*, workhub_private.t2_vlesson(l, p_ctx, p_as_of) AS v FROM workhub.timetable_lessons l
     WHERE l.school_id = p_ctx.school_id
       AND l.starts_at >= (lower(p_range)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_tz) - interval '1 day' AND l.starts_at < (upper(p_range)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE v_tz)
       AND workhub_private.t2_in(l.starts_at, l.ends_at, p_range, v_tz)
  )
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM vl),
         jsonb_build_object(
           'unknownGroup', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(v_groups) g WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vl CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements(vl.groups) x WHERE x ->> 'id' = g)),
           'src', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', vl.id, 'version', vl.version, 'v', vl.v, 's', vl.starts_at, 'e', vl.ends_at,
                                       'teachers', to_jsonb(vl.teacher_ids), 'groups', vl.groups,
                                       'joint', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(vl.groups) x WHERE NOT (x ->> 'id' = ANY (v_groups))),
                                       'past', vl.starts_at <= p_created,
                                       'crossing', workhub_private.t2_day(vl.starts_at, v_tz) <> v_date OR workhub_private.t2_day(vl.ends_at - interval '1 millisecond', v_tz) <> v_date)
                                     ORDER BY vl.id COLLATE "C")
                              FROM vl WHERE vl.state = 'scheduled' AND workhub_private.t2_day(vl.starts_at, v_tz) <= v_date
                               AND workhub_private.t2_day(vl.ends_at - interval '1 millisecond', v_tz) >= v_date
                               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(vl.groups) x WHERE x ->> 'id' = ANY (v_groups))), '[]'::jsonb),
           'others', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', vl.id, 's', vl.starts_at, 'e', vl.ends_at, 'teachers', to_jsonb(vl.teacher_ids), 'groups', vl.groups))
                                 FROM vl WHERE vl.state = 'scheduled' AND workhub_private.t2_day(vl.starts_at, v_tz) <= v_date
                                  AND workhub_private.t2_day(vl.ends_at - interval '1 millisecond', v_tz) >= v_date), '[]'::jsonb))
    INTO v_cnt, v_flags;
  IF v_cnt > workhub_private.t2_limit('lessons') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QUERY_FAILED'; END IF;
  IF (v_flags ->> 'unknownGroup')::boolean THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INPUT'; END IF;
  v_src := v_flags -> 'src';
  -- 종: 새 시각은 그날 안(그대로 둔 자정 경계 수업만 예외) · 특별 일과의 변경 전 시각 = 대상 수업 시각 전부
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(i -> 'bells') b
              WHERE NOT (workhub_private.t2_day((b #>> '{after,startsAt}')::timestamptz, v_tz) = v_date
                         AND workhub_private.t2_day((b #>> '{after,endsAt}')::timestamptz - interval '1 millisecond', v_tz) = v_date)
                AND NOT (b -> 'before' = b -> 'after' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_src) x WHERE x #> '{v,time}' = b -> 'before')))
     OR (i ->> 'kind' = 'special_bells'
         AND (SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT x #>> '{v,time}' ORDER BY x #>> '{v,time}'), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_src) x)
             IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT (b -> 'before')::text ORDER BY (b -> 'before')::text), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM jsonb_array_elements(i -> 'bells') b)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_INPUT';
  END IF;
  -- 바뀌는 수업(대상 중 차단 사유가 없는 것). 특별 일과에서 시각이 그대로인 수업은 바꾸지 않는다.
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(ch ORDER BY ch #>> '{after,id}' COLLATE "C"), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_changes FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('before', x -> 'v', 'after', CASE WHEN i ->> 'kind' = 'closure'
             THEN (x -> 'v') || jsonb_build_object('version', (x ->> 'version')::integer + 1, 'state', 'cancelled', 'canRequest', false, 'allowedTargets', '[]'::jsonb)
             ELSE (x -> 'v') || jsonb_build_object('version', (x ->> 'version')::integer + 1, 'time', b -> 'after', 'allowedTargets', '[]'::jsonb, 'canRequest', false) END) AS ch
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_src) x
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT b FROM jsonb_array_elements(i -> 'bells') b WHERE b -> 'before' = x #> '{v,time}') bb ON true
     WHERE NOT (x ->> 'joint')::boolean AND NOT (x ->> 'past')::boolean AND NOT (x ->> 'crossing')::boolean
       AND NOT (i ->> 'kind' = 'special_bells' AND bb.b -> 'after' = x #> '{v,time}')) z;
  -- 걸린 교환 요청(화면이 본 요청 중 진행 중 · 반영된 것)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('requestId', q.v ->> 'id', 'version', (q.v -> 'version'), 'state', q.v ->> 'state', 'handling', 'blocked')
                            ORDER BY q.v ->> 'id' COLLATE "C"), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_effects
    FROM (SELECT workhub_private.t2_req_view(r, p_ctx, p_as_of) AS v FROM workhub.timetable_exchange_requests r
           WHERE r.school_id = p_ctx.school_id AND r.first_day < upper(p_range) AND r.last_day >= lower(p_range) AND r.created_at <= p_as_of
             AND workhub_private.t2_req_visible(r, p_ctx)) q
   WHERE q.v ->> 'state' IN ('awaiting_consent','awaiting_approval','applied')
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(q.v -> 'changes') c JOIN jsonb_array_elements(v_src) x ON x ->> 'id' = c #>> '{after,id}');
  -- 차단 사유(앱이 요구하는 코드 그대로, 코드마다 1개)
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_src) x WHERE (x ->> 'joint')::boolean) THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'PARTIAL_GROUP_SCOPE', 'message', '고르지 않은 학급 · 수강집단과 함께 듣는 수업이 있습니다. 함께 듣는 집단을 모두 고르거나 따로 조정해 주세요.'));
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_src) x WHERE (x ->> 'past')::boolean) THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'PAST_RECORD', 'message', '이미 시작한 수업이 있습니다. 지난 기록은 바꾸지 않습니다.'));
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_src) x WHERE (x ->> 'crossing')::boolean) THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'CROSS_DAY_LESSON', 'message', '날짜를 넘기는 수업은 이 화면에서 바꾸지 않습니다.'));
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_src) = 0 THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'NO_LESSONS', 'message', '그날 고른 학급 · 수강집단의 예정 수업이 없습니다.'));
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_changes) c WHERE c #>> '{after,state}' <> 'cancelled' AND (c #>> '{after,time,startsAt}')::timestamptz <= p_created) THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'PAST_TARGET', 'message', '새 시각이 이미 지났습니다.'));
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_effects) > 0 THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'EXISTING_EXCHANGE', 'message', '진행 중이거나 반영된 교환 요청이 걸린 수업이 있습니다. 요청을 먼저 정리해 주세요.'));
  END IF;
  -- 겹침: 바뀐 뒤 그날 수업끼리 교사 · 학급(수강집단)이 겹치는가(앱과 같은 검사) + 공간 정원(서버 추가 검사)
  WITH fin AS (
    SELECT o ->> 'id' AS id, COALESCE((c #>> '{after,time,startsAt}')::timestamptz, (o ->> 's')::timestamptz) AS s,
           COALESCE((c #>> '{after,time,endsAt}')::timestamptz, (o ->> 'e')::timestamptz) AS e, o -> 'teachers' AS t, o -> 'groups' AS g, c IS NOT NULL AS changed
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_flags -> 'others') o LEFT JOIN jsonb_array_elements(v_changes) c ON c #>> '{after,id}' = o ->> 'id'
     WHERE c IS NULL OR c #>> '{after,state}' <> 'cancelled'
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin a JOIN fin b ON a.id < b.id AND (a.changed OR b.changed) AND a.s < b.e AND b.s < a.e
                  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(a.t) x JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(b.t) y ON x = y)
                     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.g) x JOIN jsonb_array_elements(b.g) y ON x ->> 'id' = y ->> 'id'))
      OR cardinality(workhub_private.t2_conflicts(p_ctx.school_id,
           COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', l.id, 's', c #>> '{after,time,startsAt}', 'e', c #>> '{after,time,endsAt}', 'uses', l.uses))
                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_changes) c JOIN workhub.timetable_lessons l ON l.school_id = p_ctx.school_id AND l.id = c #>> '{after,id}'
                      WHERE c #>> '{after,state}' <> 'cancelled'), '[]'::jsonb),
           ARRAY(SELECT c #>> '{after,id}' FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_changes) c WHERE c #>> '{after,state}' = 'cancelled'))) > 0
    INTO v_conf;
  IF v_conf THEN
    v_blockers := v_blockers || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', 'message', '바뀐 시각에 같은 교사 · 학급 · 공간을 쓰는 수업이 겹칩니다.'));
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE c #>> '{after,state}' = 'cancelled'),
         COALESCE(sum(greatest(0, extract(epoch FROM ((c #>> '{before,time,endsAt}')::timestamptz - (c #>> '{before,time,startsAt}')::timestamptz))
                               - CASE WHEN c #>> '{after,state}' = 'cancelled' THEN 0
                                      ELSE extract(epoch FROM ((c #>> '{after,time,endsAt}')::timestamptz - (c #>> '{after,time,startsAt}')::timestamptz)) END)), 0)::bigint
    INTO v_cnt, v_lost FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_changes) c;
  v_body := jsonb_build_object('input', i, 'sourceAsOf', workhub_private.t2_ts(p_as_of), 'previewId', p_id,
    'createdAt', workhub_private.t2_ts(p_created), 'expiresAt', workhub_private.t2_ts(p_expires), 'complete', true,
    'coverage', jsonb_build_object('date', i -> 'date', 'groupIds', i -> 'groupIds', 'complete', true, 'existingRequests', 'complete'),
    'affectedLessons', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lessonId', x ->> 'id', 'version', x -> 'version') ORDER BY x ->> 'id' COLLATE "C")
                                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_src) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'changes', v_changes, 'requestEffects', v_effects, 'blockers', v_blockers,
    'preserved', jsonb_build_object('pastRecords', true, 'outsideTarget', true, 'existingChanges', CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(v_effects) > 0 THEN 'blocked' ELSE 'retained' END),
    'lostLessonCount', v_cnt, 'lostSeconds', v_lost, 'changesActualSchedule', false);
  RETURN v_body || jsonb_build_object('previewHash', workhub_private.p2_sha(v_body));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION workhub_private.t2_exec_get(p_ctx workhub_private.actor_context, p_lesson text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE l workhub.timetable_lessons; r workhub.timetable_execution_records; v_at timestamptz := workhub_private.t2_now(); v_hist jsonb;
BEGIN
  l := workhub_private.t2_exec_source(p_ctx, p_lesson);
  SELECT * INTO r FROM workhub.timetable_execution_records WHERE school_id = p_ctx.school_id AND lesson_id = l.id;
  v_hist := CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE workhub_private.t2_exec_page(r.id, r.version) END;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('asOf', workhub_private.t2_ts(v_at), 'timeZone', p_ctx.school_timezone, 'lesson', workhub_private.t2_exec_lesson(l),
    'allowedOutcomes', CASE WHEN p_ctx.membership_id = ANY (l.teacher_ids) AND l.state = 'scheduled' AND l.ends_at <= v_at
                              AND COALESCE(r.version, 0) < 2147483647
                            THEN '["completed","not_performed","needs_review"]'::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
    'current', CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE v_hist -> 0 END,
    'history', v_hist,
    'nextCursor', to_jsonb(CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE workhub_private.t2_exec_cursor(p_ctx, l.id, r.id, r.version, r.version - 20) END));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION workhub_private.t3_live(r workhub.timetable_interventions, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT r.state IN('awaiting_consent','awaiting_approval') AND r.expires_at>p_at AND NOT workhub_private.t3_stale(r) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION workhub_private.t3_view(r workhub.timetable_interventions, ctx workhub_private.actor_context, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'version',r.version,'proposalHash',r.proposal_hash,
 'state',CASE WHEN r.state NOT IN('awaiting_consent','awaiting_approval') THEN r.state WHEN workhub_private.t3_stale(r) THEN 'stale' WHEN r.expires_at<=p_at THEN 'expired' ELSE r.state END,
 'kind',r.kind,'input',r.input,'requester',jsonb_build_object('id',r.requester_membership_id,'name',workhub_private.t2_member_name(r.requester_membership_id)),
 'requesterIsViewer',r.requester_account_id=ctx.account_id,'createdAt',workhub_private.t2_ts(r.created_at),'expiresAt',workhub_private.t2_ts(r.expires_at),
 'reason',r.input->>'reason','changes',r.plan->'changes','participants',
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.membership_id,'name',(SELECT x->>'name' FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.plan->'participants') x WHERE x->>'id'=p.membership_id),'response',p.response,
 'respondedAt',CASE WHEN p.responded_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE workhub_private.t2_ts(p.responded_at) END) ORDER BY p.membership_id)
 FROM workhub.timetable_intervention_participants p WHERE p.intervention_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb),'actions',workhub_private.t3_actions(r,ctx,p_at)) $function$
